target: AArch64 PCI QEMU, one guest CPU, rebuilt current desktop ISO
command: QEMU=build/utm-qemu-probe/qemu-probe QEMU_VIRT='-L /Applications/UTM.app/Contents/Resources/qemu -machine virt,accel=hvf,gic-version=3 -cpu host -smp 1 -m 1024 -device virtio-ramfb -device virtio-keyboard-device -device virtio-tablet-device' ZEAL_COMPAT_LOG_PATH=build/check-logic-current-2026-11-11.log python3 -u scripts/check-compat.py --pci --quick --probe-logic-program
verified: Original Digital Logic app displayed ten exact gate bitmaps and rendered AND/OR circuits.
Interactive setup prompt accepted values and visible backspace editing.
All setup cancellation paths, Shift+Escape, relaunch and clean exit returned to the terminal.
scope_note: One-vCPU QEMU acceptance for the current ISO, not a full inventory of ZealOS applications and not UTM or Pi hardware acceptance.
